div.div:
KIND 1: WORKFORCE — HUMANS WHO OPERATE AWS (Landing Zone §4, Security §5.3)
• Directory: IAM Identity Center (Organization instance in Management Account, Delegated Admin in Security Account) [D06]
• Authentication: Mandatory MFA via TOTP software token on EVERY sign-in. Zero IAM users, zero static access keys (A08 §3.1).
• Permission Sets & Session Lifetimes (Narrow operations sets exempt from production-change SCP | A08 §3.1):
- PlatformReadOnly: Workload & Network accounts. Read-only on resources, CloudWatch metrics, AWSIotLogsV2, audit logs. (4 hours)
- DeviceRevocation: Workload accounts. iot:UpdateCertificate, DetachPolicy, DetachThingPrincipal, UpdateThing fallback. (1 hour)
- IdentitySupport: Workload accounts. cognito-idp:AdminDisableUser, AdminUserGlobalSignOut, AdminAdd/RemoveUserFromGroup. (1 hour)
- Auditor: Security account. Read audit archive through Amazon Athena queries and organization CloudTrail (ASM-099). (4 hours)
- BreakGlass: All accounts. Emergency administrator access; every use immediately alerts platform operators and auditor. (1 hour)
• Pipeline Boundary: Platform operators change production infrastructure ONLY through GitHub OIDC pipeline, never via permission sets.

div.div:
KIND 4: CI/CD PIPELINES & PLATFORM SERVICE IDENTITIES (ADR-003, Security §2, B06)
• CI/CD Pipeline Identity:
- Provider: GitHub Actions via GitHub OIDC Identity Provider in each environment account (dev, qa, pdn) [D06, D11, D12].
- Authentication: OIDC token exchanged for short-lived AWS STS assume-role credentials (ADR-003). Zero static keys in repo or state.
- Scoped Roles: Separate Plan Role (read-only state + dry run) and Apply Role (least privilege per domain stack) (ASM-051).
• Platform IAM Service Roles (Least Privilege, Security Stack B06 [D06]):
- Inference Function Roles: 4 Bedrock vision function roles; granted bedrock:InvokeModel; DENIED personal and restricted keys.
- Threshold Function Role [D10]: Consumes SQS threshold queue; evaluates reading; writes alerts; calls SNS alert dispatcher.
- Reception Function Role: Links S3 flight objects to mission records; quarantines unauthorized objects; DENIED personal key.
- IoT Core Topic Rule Role [D09]: Assumed by IoT rules engine to write DynamoDB telemetry table and publish to SQS threshold queue.
- Sack Lookup Service Role: Lambda Function URL role; granted DynamoDB GetItem on buyer_view ONLY; ZERO access to records/personal.

div.div:
KIND 2: APPLICATION USERS — AMAZON COGNITO DIRECTORY ARCHITECTURE (Security §3, §4.1, §5 | ASM-090)
• Managed Directory: Amazon Cognito user pools on Essentials feature plan in us-east-1, Workload Account (pdn, qa, dev) [D06].
• Two Separate User Pools: Pool-wide MFA setting enforces security boundaries by infrastructure configuration, not application logic.
• Token Architecture: JWT tokens (ID, Access, Refresh). Token carries sub, phone/email, and group. NO scopes or farm lists inside tokens!
• Pre-Authentication Trigger: Lambda trigger strictly enforces 1 identity = 1 role; rejects sign-in if user has multiple groups (ASM-099).

div.div:
STAFF USER POOL: staff (MFA REQUIRED | TOTP | §3.2, §5.1)
• MFA Policy: REQUIRED software token TOTP from authenticator app.
• Sign-In: Username + Password + TOTP code. Token revocation enabled.
• Sensitive Staff Step-Up Authentication (ASM-092):
- Operations: Fumigation authorization, threshold update, revocation, identity admin.
- Rule: Token auth_time must be <= 10 minutes old; otherwise app prompts for fresh TOTP.
• Groups & Client Applications:
- collection_center_operator: Logistics workstation app & reports web. (Own center)
- drone_operator: Drone ground-station app (10.4x.2.10). (Assigned missions)
- agronomist: Reports web. Authorizes fumigations (ADR-002). (Department scope)
- platform_operator: Reports web operations screens. (Whole platform, no business writes)
• Token Lifetimes: Access token 60 min, Refresh token 30 days (ASM-092).

div.div:
FIELD USER POOL: field (NO MFA, JUSTIFIED ADOPTION DECISION | §3.2, §5.2 | ASM-091)
• MFA Policy: OFF. Intentional design decision based on case statement constraints:
- Adoption: Farmers distrust leaving notebook; farmer app has few simple screens.
- Connectivity: Operates in rural areas without continuous data coverage; offline outbox.
- Blast Radius: Narrow scope (own farms / own trips); compromised token cannot touch others.
• Sign-In: Passwordless one-time code (SMS to registered phone for farmers/transporters; Email for buyers).
• Compensating Security Controls:
- Hardware Keystore: App outbox encrypted with key in phone hardware keystore (ASM-095).
- Installation Binding: Every transaction carries unique mobile installation device_id (A10 §7).
- Local Phone Lock: App opens only after phone biometric or screen lock PIN challenge.
- Scope Enforcement: Server-side API validates caller owns target farm or trip on every call.
• Groups: farmer (Own farms), transporter (Own trips), buyer (Read-only buyer view).

div.div:
KIND 3: FIELD DEVICES — AWS IOT CORE REGISTRY & AUTHENTICATION (Security §6, ADR-003, Connectivity §4)
• Hardware Identity Directory: AWS IoT Core Thing Registry in workload account (pdn, qa, dev) [D08, D09].
• Mutual TLS Authentication: Every device authenticates with a unique X.509 client certificate registered from a CSR generated on-device (ADR-003, ASM-010).
- Private key never leaves device hardware non-volatile secure storage; never seen by Terraform, pipeline, or human operator.
- Port 8883 (MQTT over TLS) or Port 443 with ALPN (protocol iot-mqtt). TLS 1.2+ security policy (IoTSecurityPolicy_TLS13_1_2_2022_10 | PD-100).
• Dynamic IoT Policy Variables (One policy serves 200 or 1,000 farms without naming individual devices | ADR-003):
- iot:Connect allowed ONLY if client ID equals ${iot:Connection.Thing.ThingName} and ${iot:Connection.Thing.IsAttached} is true.
- Farm Nodes (Crop & Drying, 2 per farm | ASM-070): Publish ONLY to telemetry/${iot:Connection.Thing.ThingName}. Subscribe DENIED.
- 24-Hour Offline Buffer: Stores readings locally during signal outages; drains oldest-first upon reconnection (ASM-074).
• Drone Kit Identity & Upload Grant Binding Protocol (ADR-002, Security §6, ASM-093, PD-075 closed):
- Drone Kit: Paired flight vehicle and ground station (ASM-093). Subscribes ONLY to drones/${iot:Connection.Thing.ThingName}/grants.
- Pilot-to-Drone Binding:
1. Pilot signs into staff Cognito pool with MFA; requests upload grant for specific mission from API Gateway.
2. API validates: pilot assigned to order, pilot Aerocivil permit active (ASM-020), kit assigned, kit certificate ACTIVE in IoT registry.
3. API creates upload grant in DB and publishes 15-minute S3 pre-signed URLs on kit grant topic.
4. Ground station uploads imagery/flight records to S3; reception Lambda accepts object ONLY if grant pilot and kit were active at upload.

div.div:
APPLICATION ENTRY POINTS & NETWORK BOUNDARIES (Connectivity §3, §9, Addressing §4 [D04], Sack & Trip §7.2 [PD-051])
• Anonymous Public Sack Lookup Front Door: Amazon CloudFront CDN + AWS WAF (rate limited <= 30 req/min per IP | PD-102) -> Lambda Function URL via OAC.
- Empty public_query tier; zero load balancer, zero NAT gateway charges (PD-051 closed). Reads ONLY buyer_view DynamoDB projection.
• Application API Front Door: Amazon API Gateway custom domain (HTTPS, TLS 1.2 policy) -> Regional public endpoint for mobile apps;
- Private VPC execute-api interface endpoint in application tier (10.82.48.0/20) for Collection Center logistics posts via IPsec TGW VPN [D04, D05].
• S3 Interface Endpoint: Located in object_storage tier (10.82.80.0/20) reachable from collection center Soporte LAN (10.4x.2.10) for drone uploads.
• Cognito Interface Endpoint: Located in application tier (10.82.48.0/20) allowing logistics staff to authenticate during WAN degradation.

div.div: 2. ROLES, LEAST PRIVILEGE, SCOPE ENFORCEMENT & SEPARATION OF DUTIES (Sections 3.3, 4, 8, 9)

div.style: display: flex; align-items: unsafe flex-start; justify-content: unsafe flex-start; width: 868px; height: 1px; padding-top: 162px; margin-left: 1933px;
box-sizing: border-box; font-size: 0; text-align: left; color: #0f172a;
display: inline-block; font-size: 12.5px; font-family: Helvetica; color: light-dark(#0f172a, #d3daea); line-height: 1.2; pointer-events: all; white-space: normal; word-wrap: normal;

div.div:
DYNAMIC SCOPE ENFORCEMENT MODEL (Security §3.3)
• Scope Lives in Transactional Data, NOT in JWT Tokens:
- Tokens prove identity (sub) and role group (agronomist, farmer, etc.).
- Scopes are NOT encoded in tokens (avoids stale token revocation delays).
- Scope assignments are maintained as dynamic database records:
* Own farms: Farm-to-farmer membership (maintained by Platform Operator).
* Own trips: Trip-to-transporter record (created upon custody acceptance).
* Own center: Center operator to Cauca (10.41), Huila (10.42), Tolima (10.43).
* Assigned missions: Fumigation/survey order to pilot & kit (Agronomist sets).
* Department: Agronomist to one or more departments (ASM-021).
• Immediate Effect: Adding or removing an assignment takes effect on the NEXT API request.
• Revocation Timestamp Check: API compares token auth_time against user's revoked_after attribute.
Any token issued prior to revocation is rejected instantaneously without waiting for token expiry.

rect.style: fill: light-dark(rgb(255, 251, 235), rgb(25, 22, 8)); stroke: light-dark(rgb(217, 119, 6), rgb(197, 113, 16));

div.div:
SEPARATION OF DUTIES & ARCHITECTURAL INVARIANTS (§4.3, ADR-002)
• Invariant 1: Fumigation Authorization (ADR-002, Case Part E)
- Human Identity Only: Must be signed by agronomist staff token with fresh MFA.
- Zero Automated Trigger: No Lambda function, topic rule, or AI model authorizes.
- Separation: Authorizing agronomist CANNOT be the assigned pilot (authorizer_id != operator_id).
• Invariant 2: Drone Operator Boundary
- Pilot executes missions, uploads imagery. CANNOT create, modify, or authorize orders.
• Invariant 3: Platform Operator Boundary
- Manages tenant enrollment, user accounts, and infrastructure monitoring.
- CANNOT authorize fumigation; CANNOT write sacks, custody events, trips, or orders.
• Invariant 4: One Identity = One Role (ASM-099)
- Pre-auth Lambda trigger strictly denies sign-in to users belonging to multiple role groups.
• Invariant 5: Sensitive Staff Step-Up Authentication (ASM-092)
- Token auth_time must be <= 10 min for fumigation auth, threshold change, or revocation.

box-sizing: border-box; font-size: 0; text-align: left; color: #0f172a;
display: inline-block; font-size: 12.5px; font-family: Helvetica; color: light-dark(#0f172a, #d3daea); line-height: 1.2; pointer-events: all; white-space: normal; word-wrap: normal;

div.div:
ROLE-TO-DATA ACCESS MATRIX (Summary of Security §4.2 | Least Privilege by Role & Scope)
• Farmer (field | Own farms): Read farm records, node registry, crop/drying telemetry, alerts, soil analysis, threshold ranges, expected sacks, pest case status, fumigation window. Create/Read sack registrations. Create/Read own personal profile.
• Transporter (field | Own trips): Read pickup points, sack code & weight. Create/Read sack custody events (full trace) and port delivery. Create/Read own trip GPS positions. Read/Update own personal profile. Zero access to farmer cédula, telemetry, or other trips.
• Collection-Center Operator (staff | Own center): Read farm name & municipality delivering to center. Read/Create sack registrations & local code bindings. Create reception accepted/rejected & departure events. Read open trips to/from own center. Read expected harvest sacks. Read display name & plate of delivering transporters. Zero access to farmer cédula or telemetry.
• Read-Only Buyer & Public Reader (field / anonymous): Read sack by code ONLY. Returns strictly the Buyer View Projection (origin, dates, status, drying variables). Zero access to farm records, farmer cédula, node IDs, custody events, trips, positions, weights.
• Drone Operator (staff | Assigned missions): Read farm polygons & no-fly zones for assigned missions. Read assigned mission package & fumigation order. Create flight records & drone object uploads via upload grants. Read/Update own personal profile. Zero create/auth permissions.
• Agronomist (staff | Department): Read farm polygons; Create/Update plots & preliminary no-fly zones (ASM-027). Read node registry, crop telemetry, alerts, harvest estimates, pest cases. Create/Read soil analyses. Authorize/Reject fumigation orders. Zero flight permissions.
• Platform Operator (staff | Platform scope): Create/Update farm records at enrollment; revoke devices; update thresholds (step-up MFA | ASM-099); manage application identities, groups, and scopes. Read operational metadata & audit logs. ZERO business data writes.

div.div:
SACK CODE SECURITY & THE PUBLIC BUYER VIEW PROJECTION (Security §8, Sack & Trip §7, §10 | ASM-094, ASM-096, ASM-154)
• Opaque Sack Identifier (ASM-094):
- Entropy: 80 cryptographically secure random bits generated on platform only (Crockford Base32: XXXX-XXXX-XXXX-XXXX-C with check symbol).
- Privacy Invariant: NEVER derived from cédula, name, farm ID, node ID, timestamp, sequential counter, or any hash thereof.
- Internal Decoupling: System keys sacks by internal UUID sack_id; sack code is a unique secondary index (damaged labels replaced without loss of history).
• Architectural Enforcement via Dedicated Projection Store (buyer_view DynamoDB table | CMK public_view [D06]):
- Separation: Lookup service reads ONLY from the buyer_view projection table; holds ZERO IAM or KMS permissions on records, personal, or telemetry stores!
- 4 Authorized Data Groups (Case statement Point 2 mandate):
1. Origin: sack_code, department, municipality (coarse administrative boundary; no farm name, vereda, or coordinates).
2. Processing Dates: drying_start_date, drying_end_date, packing_date (calendar dates only; no timestamps of day).
3. Status: Current sack state (in preparation, en route to center, accepted/rejected at center, en route to port, delivered at port accepted/rejected).
4. Drying Variables: final_coffee_moisture_pct, grain_temperature_min_c, grain_temperature_mean_c, grain_temperature_max_c (drying lot summary).
- Explicitly Withheld: Farmer name, cédula, phone, subject_id, coordinates, node IDs, raw telemetry, transporter name/plate, custody times, weights, pest records.

div.div:
PERSONAL DATA LIFECYCLE, PRIVACY & RETENTION ARCHITECTURE (Security §9 | ASM-098, ADR-001)
• Personal Data Inventory & Storage:
- Personal Data Table (DynamoDB | CMK personal [D06]): Stores farmer & transporter full name, cédula, phone number, vehicle plate.
- Pseudonymous subject_id: All business transactions (sacks, trips, orders, flight logs) reference persons ONLY via random opaque subject_id.
- Cédula Protection: Nobody reads another person's cédula except Platform Operator during support/enrollment. Logs carry subject_id or sub, never cédula.
• 5-Year Retention Clock & Anonymization Engine (ASM-098, Case Point 2):
- Retention Clock: Personal profile retained 5 years from user deactivation; transaction records retained 5 years from event timestamp.
- Monthly Anonymization Process: Amazon EventBridge Scheduler triggers Lambda function with scoped delete role:
* Deletes personal profile item (name, cédula, phone, plate) from personal_data table.
* Calls cognito-idp:AdminDeleteUser to permanently delete Cognito identity.
* Result: Transaction records preserve subject_id for traceability, permanently linked to nobody (full anonymization).
- DynamoDB Time-To-Live (TTL): expires_at attribute on event records and transporter positions triggers automatic serverless deletion at 5 years.
- S3 Object Expiration: S3 lifecycle rules automatically delete drone imagery and sack history JSON Lines exports after 5 years.
- Restricted Drone Imagery: Drone objects with a person (restricted/person/) encrypted under restricted key, excluded from inference, deleted after 5 years (ASM-165).

div.div:
REVOCATION POLICIES & TIME LIMITS SUMMARY (Security §10 | Target SLA: Complete within 4 hours of report | ASM-098)
• Decommissioned Farm Node / Stolen Node: Platform Operator executes iot:UpdateCertificate(REVOKED), DetachPolicy, DetachThingPrincipal, UpdateThing(status=decommissioned).
- Immediate Effect: IoT Core forcefully terminates active TLS sessions within minutes; detached policy denies all publish attempts; node buffer expires after 24h (ASM-074).
• Lost Drone Kit: Same 4 IoT Core actions (status=lost). Mission upload grants refused; pre-signed S3 URLs expire in 15 min; incoming uploads quarantined in S3.
• Departing Pilot / Agronomist: cognito-idp:AdminDisableUser, AdminUserGlobalSignOut, AdminRemoveUserFromGroup; DB sets revoked_after=NOW(). API denies calls immediately (0 min).
• Lost Phone (Farmer / Transporter): AdminUserGlobalSignOut, marks installation device_id as revoked in DB, AdminDisableUser. Outbox rejected. Re-enrolls in person at center.

div.div:
AWS KMS CUSTOMER-MANAGED KEYS (CMK) ARCHITECTURE — 8 KEYS PER ENVIRONMENT (Security §7.2, §7.3 | ADR-003, B06 [D06])
Every store uses a dedicated customer-managed key of its data class, ensuring service roles receive cryptographic access ONLY to the data they require.
Automatic Key Rotation: Enabled on ALL customer-managed keys with a 365-day rotation period (ASM-097). Previous key material preserved; zero re-encryption required.
Deletion Protection: kms:ScheduleKeyDeletion and kms:DisableKey DENIED to all principals except BreakGlass; mandatory 30-day waiting period alerts operators.

CROSS-CUTTING KEYS (MANAGEMENT & SECURITY ACCOUNTS | Landing Zone §7):
• audit CMK (Security Account | D06):
- Encrypts Central S3 Audit Archive Bucket (s3://aroma-audit-archive-shared/).
- Enforces S3 Object Lock in compliance mode (5-year retention, ASM-067).
- Grantees: AWS CloudTrail (Multi-Region Trail), Amazon Data Firehose delivery, and Auditor Athena execution role.
• budgets_sns CMK (Management Account | D06):
- Encrypts Amazon SNS budget alert notification topic. Grantees: AWS Budgets engine, AWS Cost Anomaly Detection.

div.div:
KEY ROTATION & CRYPTOGRAPHIC DELETION GOVERNANCE (Security §7.3 | ASM-097):
• 365-Day Automatic Rotation: KMS automatically rotates backing key material yearly.
Data is never re-encrypted; KMS transparently decrypts historical ciphertexts using retired keys.
• Cryptographic Erasure Guardrail:
- Key policy explicitly DENIES kms:ScheduleKeyDeletion and kms:DisableKey to all roles.
- BreakGlass role is the sole identity capable of scheduling key deletion under emergency audit.
- Maximum 30-day deletion waiting period enforced; alerts platform operators upon initiation.
• Strict Principal Isolation: No wildcard principals allowed; cross-environment decryption strictly prohibited.

rect.style: fill: light-dark(rgb(236, 253, 245), rgb(13, 27, 21)); stroke: light-dark(rgb(5, 150, 105), rgb(42, 167, 128));

div.div:
EDGE BUFFER & LOCAL STORAGE ENCRYPTION (Security §7.1 | Connectivity §4, §7 | ASM-095):
• Farm Node Flash Storage: Non-volatile circular buffer encrypted locally; retains max 24 hours of readings (ASM-074).
• Mobile Outboxes: Farmer & transporter mobile apps encrypt local queue with keys stored in hardware-backed Android Keystore / iOS Secure Enclave (ASM-095).
• Drone Ground Station: Contracted drone company required by agreement to encrypt all local flight storage and image caches (ASM-095).

rect.style: fill: light-dark(rgb(240, 249, 255), rgb(18, 26, 31)); stroke: light-dark(rgb(2, 132, 199), rgb(52, 163, 221));

div.div:
ENCRYPTION IN TRANSIT — ZERO UNENCRYPTED FLOWS (Security §7.1, Connectivity §2)
Every network flow utilizes TLS 1.2 or higher end-to-end; no proxy, relay, or load balancer terminates TLS (A10 §2).
• AWS IoT Core Data Endpoint (Port 8883 / 443 ALPN):
- Mutual TLS (mTLS) with client certificates; security policy IoTSecurityPolicy_TLS13_1_2_2022_10 (PD-100).
• Public Front Door (CloudFront & Public Sack Lookup):
- HTTPS only. Enforces minimum protocol TLSv1.2_2021 with AWS WAF inspection (PD-051 closed).
• Application API Gateway (Public & Private Endpoints):
- Custom domain enforcing HTTPS only with security policy TLS_1_2. HTTP requests refused/redirected.
• Amazon S3 Buckets (Drone Objects, Exports, Audit Archive):
- Bucket policies strictly DENY requests with aws:SecureTransport: false or s3:TlsVersion < 1.2.
- Uploads carry SHA-256 per-part checksums validated on ingestion (A10 §6).
• Collection Center WAN (Site-to-Site VPN):
- Dual IPsec IKEv2 tunnels connecting each center firewall to AWS Transit Gateway hub in network account (ASM-078).
- Center LAN traffic to cloud interface endpoints is itself encrypted TLS inside the IPsec tunnel.
• Service-to-Service Communication (Within AWS):
- AWS SDK calls over HTTPS/TLS; VPC traffic reaches AWS services via AWS PrivateLink interface endpoints (execute-api, cognito-idp, S3, logs) without crossing public internet [D04, PC-IAC-020].
